snippet.title: Drunkonauts - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
What happens when you give astronauts jetpacks, physics, and way too many throwable objects?

Welcome to Drunkonauts, a chaotic zero-gravity multiplayer party game where anything can become a weapon!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603900/Drunkonauts

Join the Closed Beta (open till Monday October 6, 16:00 UTC): https://discord.gg/gBqqWPwj5k
